section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1970
title: 10 Table V furnishes the distribution of accidental deaths by sex in the different States, Union Territories and Cities. On an average, 63.8% of the persons who were involved in accidental deaths were males. A similar pattern has been observed in almost all the States, excepting Assam, Himachal Pradesh, Manipur, Nagaland and Punjab where the percentage of male casualties was 72.5, 79.0, 86.4, 98.6 and 81.8 respectively. Among the Union Territories, the overall percentage (74.8) of male involvement was higher than the All-India average. Among the comparable cities, the percentage involvement of males was higher in Bombay (75.1), Calcutta (77.6) and Delhi (77.5) while, in Ahmedabad, this percentage was 57.9. In the other cities, it was more or less at par with the All-India average.
